Statement I: Rebate refers to offering special reduced prices to clear off excess inventory.
Statement II: Sampling involves offering extra quantity of the same product without extra charge, such as 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free'.

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
